001package dev.nandi0813.api.Interface;
002
003import org.bukkit.World;
004import org.bukkit.util.BoundingBox;
005
006/**
007 * An arena leased from ZonePractice Pro by an addon. Main thread only.
008 * @since 2.11.0
009 */
010public interface ArenaLease {
011
012    /**
013     * Get the name of the leased arena or arena copy.
014     * @return The leased arena name, never null
015     */
016    String getArenaName();
017
018    /**
019     * Get the name of the arena the lease was asked for. For a copy this is the original arena.
020     * @return The original arena name, never null
021     */
022    String getOriginalArenaName();
023
024    /**
025     * @return The world of the leased arena
026     */
027    World getWorld();
028
029    /**
030     * Get the box covering every block of the arena region. The upper corner is exclusive.
031     * @return The arena bounds, never null
032     */
033    BoundingBox getBounds();
034
035    /**
036     * @return true if the arena is a build arena or an arena copy, which no match can share
037     */
038    boolean isBuild();
039
040    /**
041     * @return true until {@link #release()} is called or the owner plugin disables
042     */
043    boolean isActive();
044
045    /**
046     * Releases the arena. Main thread only. Safe to call more than once.
047     */
048    void release();
049
050}
